free_tier.stated: No free trial; pay-as-you-go with no minimum commitment. Billing is per second while an instance is running. Prices are per GPU-hour by priority tier (High, Medium, Low, Lowest), with vCPU and RAM included: RTX 4090 24 GB USD 0.440 High, 0.347 Medium, 0.253 Low, 0.160 Lowest. Classes below the table start at USD 0.015 per GPU-hour at Lowest priority. Medium and Low tiers can be preempted, with a minimum run before reallocation of roughly 30 minutes. The page lists no H100, A100, L40S or L4.

chaining: None without a first payment. USD 0.015/h is the cheapest per-hour GPU figure found in this class, so it is the right target once any budget exists.

limits.value: There is no free lane at all, so the binding constraint is the first dollar: a user must fund a prepaid balance before any container runs.
